question: The Nehru Cup, a prominent international football tournament in India, was last held in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2012**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The last edition of the Nehru Cup was held in **2012** in New Delhi, India.
 
• It was organized by the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)**.
 
• The tournament was won by **India**, defeating Cameroon in the final via penalty shootout.
 
• The Nehru Cup was an invitational international football tournament initiated in **1982**.
 
• The event was discontinued after 2012 due to financial constraints and a shift in AIFF’s focus towards domestic football development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nehru Cup Overview:**

 
 
• Named after India’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• Initially aimed at promoting international football in India.
 
• Featured teams from Asia, Africa, and Europe during its active years.
 
 
 
• **2012 Nehru Cup Highlights:**
 
 
• India defeated Cameroon 5-4 on penalties after a 2-2 draw in regulation time.
 
• Sunil Chhetri captained the Indian team and played a pivotal role in the victory.
 
 
 
• **Discontinuation of Nehru Cup:**
 
 
• Financial issues and lack of sponsorship led to its discontinuation.
 
• AIFF shifted focus to the Indian Super League (ISL) and other domestic tournaments.
 
 
 
• **India’s Football Development:**
 
 
• Post-2012, AIFF prioritized grassroots programs and professional league structures.
 
• Indian Super League (ISL), launched in 2014, became the flagship football competition in India.
